spellbook.finance/limitations: An enabled trial assigns exact eBay printing, finish and condition identities to fixed equal-probability control or treatment arms; it is not adaptive, does not establish a winner, and does not guarantee profit.
Creation does not activate the profile, pin it to a channel, publish a listing or immediately trigger repricing.
Only seller-approved fields are accepted; repair, deletion and default generation are unavailable.

description: Create one seller pricing profile from a seller-selected name and explicit baseline multiplier and floor, with optional dollar offset, ordinary channel overrides, or a fixed equal-probability eBay base-price trial. A trial requires an explicit experiment id, positive allocation epoch and two different seller-selected multipliers. Returns saved profile and pin readback. It does not activate, publish or immediately reprice.

basePriceTrial.description: Optional fixed equal-probability eBay base-price trial. Seller supplies both multipliers; this is not adaptive.

allocationEpoch.description: Positive revision for this trial configuration; assignment stays stable for the experiment id. Use a new experimentId to create a new allocation.

enabled.description: Explicitly enable or disable the fixed trial.

treatmentMultiplier.description: Seller-selected treatment market multiplier; must differ while enabled.

valueBands.description: Optional ordinary market-value bands for this channel.

floor.description: Seller minimum price in USD for this value band. Omit to inherit the profile floor.

label.description: Seller label for this ordinary market-value band. Omit when unlabeled.

marketOffsetUsd.description: Seller dollar adjustment after the market multiplier. Omit for no adjustment.

maxUsd.description: Exclusive upper market value in USD. Omit for no upper bound.

minUsd.description: Inclusive lower market value in USD. Required.

mult.description: Seller multiplier for this value band. Required.

channelOverrides.description: Seller-approved overrides by marketplace channel. Omit when none are needed.

floor.description: Explicit baseline floor in USD. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the seller selected. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_pricing_profile_create
